main_text.head: FORMA REIP. IN VRBE, ET MAGISTRATVVM ORDO.
main_text.p: Forma reip. in urbe ARISTOCRATICA est, modicè in democratiam declinans; quam exponere nunc animus est. Antiquitus, cum minor adhuc civitatis fortuna esset, Ra-tionales quatuor, Oldermanni VIII eam administrarunt. Senatus Nunc vero ab annis amplius trecentis CONSULES quatuor summum locum in ea tenent dignitatis. His additi olim XVI, nunc & proximis saculis XII SENATORES: qui omnes senatum conficiunt, totius reip. caput. Penes hunc senatum est jurisdictio urbana, potestasq; in rebus urbanis edicendi, decernendi vocandi, prehendendi, in custodiam dandi, coercendi, supplicia extrema irrogandi, gratia faciendi, pecuniam publicam tractandi, plerosq; magistratus alios, creandi, imprimis Hovetmannos illos, de quibus dixi saepe, praefectos item territoriorum extra urbem designandi, delectos edendi, qui in collegiis sedeant domi ac foris, quaestores, aedilem reip. aeditnos, publicanos eligendi, legationes mittendi: denique, huius officij est, toti reip. consulere, & in eam curas suas intendere. Senatorium munus bienne est, ita comparatum

page.notes: The initial letter is a large woodcut decorated E, joined to the word "Eorma" / rendered as "Ormareip." in the scan; the first word is taken from the running text as printed. "Oldermanni" and "Hovetmannos" are as printed. The word "bienne" at the end of the page may contain a Cyrillic-looking letter; read as "bienne" in Latin letters. The line "Senatorium munus bienne est, ita comparatum" runs on to the next page with the catchword "ut". The reading of the Roman numerals VIII, XVI and XII and the printed page number "159" is taken from the scan and may be uncertain at this resolution.
